The diagram shows a system to control the thickness of paper produced by a machine.
The graph shows how the count rate at the detector varies with the thickness of the paper.
The rollers squeeze the paper when the count rate at the detector drops below 12 counts per
second and then stop squeezing when the count rate rises above 13 counts per second.
